import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    res = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        j = i
        while j < len(s) and s[j] == s[i]:
            j += 1
        res += (j - i + 1) % 2
        i = j
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
